metrics.name: cumulative_group_pnl_percent
metrics.description: PnL for the date range (as a proportion of ABS(Sum of SOD NMV netted by issuer-liquidity)), summed across all days in the period. Only includes days where SOD NMV (netted by issuer-liquidity) is greater than 20.0bps

metrics.name: cumulative_alpha_pnl_percent
metrics.description: Alpha PnL as a percentage of SOD NMV for the period, computed by subtracting Beta PnL from Total PnL (accounting for the benchmark Rtn and the exposure of the position or group), summed across all days in the period. Only includes days where SOD NMV (netted by issuer-liquidity) is greater than 20.0bps

metrics.name: cumulative_benchmark_pnl_percent
metrics.description: Benchmark Return (Rtn) for the period, calculated based on geometric compounding of daily returns, computed as ((1+[t1 rtn])*(1+[t2 rtn])*(1+[t3 rtn])...*(1+tn rtn])-1)

metrics.name: average_net_exposure
metrics.description: Average Net Exposure (NMV) over the selected time period (in USD)

metrics.name: cumulative_simple_alpha_pnl_percent_nav
metrics.description: Simple Alpha PnL for the period - Fund alpha performance computed as the direct difference between period's PnL (% NAV) and benchmark's total return for that period: [Demo PnL % NAV] - [Benchmark Rtn]

metrics.name: cumulative_net_adjusted_alpha_pnl_percent_nav
metrics.description: Net Adjusted Alpha PnL for the period - Fund alpha performance computed as the direct difference between period's PnL (% NAV) and benchmark's total return adjusted for average net market value for that period: [Demo PnL % NAV] - ([Benchmark Rtn] * [Average NMV % NAV])

metrics.name: average_net_exposure_percent

metrics.name: cumulative_merged_pnl_percent_nav
metrics.description: Merged Analyst PnL for the period - Combined primary and secondary analyst performance computed as period's Primary PnL (% NAV) + 0.5 * period's Secondary PnL (% NAV)

metrics.name: average_cost
metrics.description: Cost Basis or Average Cost, calculated as a quantity-weighted average converted to USD across all unexploded (non-basket) positions. Only applicable to non basket positions, as basket constituents do not have a known cost per share.

metrics.name: native_average_cost
metrics.description: Cost Basis or Average Cost, calculated as a quantity-weighted average in local currency across all unexploded (non-basket) positions. Only applicable to non basket positions, as basket constituents do not have a known cost per share.

metrics.name: whale_minnow_tag

metrics.name: venture_analyst_avatars

metrics.name: moic
metrics.description: [Total value of all PRIVATE and PUBLIC positions (if derived from a prior private DI position) + any distributions attributable to those positions] / [Total capital invested as a private investment]. If a DI subsequently becomes public, MOIC continues tracking using the original DI tax lot(s). Includes realized + unrealized value in the numerator. Covers the full investment period including both public and private phases, calculated using inception-to-date history.

metrics.name: xirr
metrics.description: The discount rate that, applied to the time series of DI purchase cash flows, produces a net present value of zero. The current value (private or public) is the final cash flow. ITD XIRR captures the full investment history including post-IPO performance. Covers the full investment period including both public and private phases, calculated using inception-to-date history.

metrics.name: holding_period_years
metrics.description: Date of first cash outflow to date of last cash inflow (if fully realized) or current date (if unrealized), expressed in years. Covers the full investment period including both public and private phases, calculated using inception-to-date history. Counted as calendar days.

metrics.name: total_invested_capital
metrics.description: Total capital deployed — the sum of all purchase costs for this investment from inception.

metrics.name: alpha
metrics.description: Cumulative alpha vs the selected benchmark (default: XBI)

metrics.name: alpha_vs_xbi
metrics.description: Alpha PnL vs XBI US Equity as a percentage of SOD NMV for the period, computed by subtracting Beta PnL from Total PnL (accounting for the benchmark Rtn and the exposure of the position or group), summed across all days in the period. Only includes days where SOD NMV (netted by issuer-liquidity) is greater than 20.0bps. Based on positions data available from Jan 1, 2021. Metrics may understate performance for investments initiated before 2021.

metrics.name: alpha_vs_rgushsbt
metrics.description: Alpha PnL vs RGUSHSBT Index as a percentage of SOD NMV for the period, computed by subtracting Beta PnL from Total PnL (accounting for the benchmark Rtn and the exposure of the position or group), summed across all days in the period. Only includes days where SOD NMV (netted by issuer-liquidity) is greater than 20.0bps. Based on positions data available from Jan 1, 2021. Metrics may understate performance for investments initiated before 2021.

metrics.name: ta
metrics.description: Therapeutic area of the company's drug programs (KG-derived). Each drug is attributed winner-take-all to the therapeutic area of its most-advanced indication, weighted by the drug's valuation-attribution weight and normalized per company.

metrics.name: modality
metrics.description: Drug modality / type of the company's drug programs (KG-derived, drug-level), weighted by the drug's valuation-attribution weight and normalized per company.

metrics.name: stage
metrics.description: Development stage of the company's drug programs (KG-derived). Each drug is attributed winner-take-all to the stage of its most-advanced indication, weighted by the drug's valuation-attribution weight and normalized per company.

metrics.name: geography
metrics.description: Region of the company's drug programs (KG-derived) — the region of the most-advanced/marketed geography of each drug's most-advanced indication, weighted by the drug's valuation-attribution weight and normalized per company. This is the drug program's region, NOT the security's country-of-risk or the company's headquarters.
